hud.cast.where: Gameplay HUD, big round action button; probably the same slot that turns into hud.reel when a fish bites

hud.reel.where: Gameplay HUD, big round action button shown while a fish bites (replaces hud.cast)

hud.bait_left.where: Gameplay HUD, counter of bait the player has left

hud.backpack.where: Gameplay HUD, button that opens the inventory of caught fish

catch.success.where: Toast after a fish is landed

catch.escaped.where: Toast when the hooked fish escapes

catch.new_record.where: Toast after catching a record-weight fish

fish.golden_carp.where: Fish card in the backpack; also inserted as {fish} into catch.success

fish.lantern_eel.where: Fish card in the backpack; also inserted as {fish} into catch.success

rarity.mythic.where: Rarity tag on fish cards; also inserted as {rarity} into catch.success

shop.equip.where: Shop, button under a rod the player owns

shop.equipped.where: Shop, label on the rod currently in use

shop.free.where: Shop, price label on the starter rod

shop.buy_robux.where: Shop, purchase button on a game pass card

pass.auto_reel.where: Shop, name on the Auto Reel game pass card

pass.lucky_bait.text: Mồi May Mắn nhân đôi cơ hội câu được cá hiếm!
pass.lucky_bait.where: Shop, description on the Lucky Bait game pass card

sell.all.where: Fish market, button that sells every fish in the backpack

sell.done.text: Đã bán {count} con cá được {coins} xu!
sell.done.where: Toast after selling at the fish market

sell.prompt.where: Proximity prompt at the fish market stall (in the 3D world)

ascend.button.where: Ascend (prestige) button; exact screen not known

ascend.confirm.text: Thăng hạng ngay? Bạn sẽ chơi lại từ đầu, nhưng câu được cá hiếm thường xuyên hơn {bonus}%.
ascend.confirm.where: Confirm dialog shown after pressing Ascend

weather.storm.text: Bão sắp tới! Cá hiếm đang cắn câu.
weather.storm.where: Server-wide banner during a storm weather event

quest.catch_n.text: Câu {n} con cá ở Vịnh Ánh Trăng

quest.claim.where: Quests panel, button on a finished quest

friends.boost.text: Câu cá cùng bạn bè được +{percent}% may mắn

trade.sent.text: Đã gửi lời mời giao dịch cho {player}
trade.sent.where: Toast after you send a trade request

trade.accept.text: {player} đã đồng ý giao dịch với bạn
trade.accept.where: Toast when the other player accepts your trade request

codes.enter.where: Codes panel, placeholder in the text box where players type a promo code

codes.redeemed.text: Nhập code thành công! Tận hưởng phần quà nhé!
codes.redeemed.where: Toast after a valid promo code is accepted

afk.kicked.text: Bạn AFK quá lâu nên đã dừng câu cá.
afk.kicked.where: Message after 15 minutes idle; may be a kick message or an in-game popup (not known)

settings.back.where: Settings panel, button that closes the panel

settings.sfx.where: Settings panel, row label (likely beside a toggle or slider)

event.ends.where: Label under an event banner (probably the weather.storm banner or a timed event; not known)

daily.streak.text: Chuỗi {day} ngày! Ngày mai quay lại để nhận thêm quà nhé!
daily.streak.where: Daily login reward panel, main message

tip.night.text: Mẹo: Có loài cá chỉ cắn câu vào ban đêm.

group.join.text: Tham gia cộng đồng của chúng mình để nhận 50 mồi miễn phí!
group.join.where: Banner inviting players to join the studio's Roblox group
